field_conflicts.label: Six-round table-index and cost reconciliation
field_conflicts.description: Printed Algorithm2 indexes Tr by one32bit column of L^-1(c), but Section5.2 occupancy uses N=2^96 and at most9items. With D=2^88.2 the printed32bit bucket average is2^56.2, not the96bit model2^-7.8. A three-column collision key may express intended test but is not what the printed table stores. Preserve reported2^88.2E pending source/code reconciliation; do not invent a repaired implementation budget.

field_conflicts.label: Exchanged-diagonal notation outside stated domain
field_conflicts.description: PDF19 writes P5(3,1)≈2^-38, but Theorem5 requires0<|I|<4-|K|; i3,k1 exchanges all differing diagonals and only reverses the pair. Literal formula gives approximately2^-22 outside its nontrivial domain. Theorem7 correctly uses j1,2 for t3 and P5(1,1),P5(2,1)≈2^-38. The headline may follow intended counting, but this notation is not a valid literal substitution.
